description: Phase 4 Operations: Inbound (PO → Receipt → Putaway), Outbound (SO → Order → Allocation → Ship), Transfer + Inventory Adjustment

referenceId.note: Points to receipt/order depending on type

requiredSamples.featureSchema:
// Reference: weighbridges schema
import { z } from 'zod'

export const weighbridgeSchema = z.object({
    id: z.string(),
    code: z.string(),
    name: z.string(),
    maxCapacityKg: z.number(),
    integrationMode: z.string(),
    warehouseId: z.string(),
    warehouseName: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    isActive: z.boolean().default(true),
    createdTime: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    createdBy: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    updatedTime: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    updatedBy: z.string().optional().nullable(),
})

export type Weighbridge = z.infer<typeof weighbridgeSchema>

inbound: BR-4A-001: PO can only be edited in Draft status
BR-4A-002: PO confirm posts EXPECTED InventTrans for all lines
BR-4A-003: Receipt line receives lot_id via GetOrCreateLot at receive
BR-4A-004: Receipt posts PHYSICAL InventTrans at RECEIVING location + reverses EXPECTED
BR-4A-005: Putaway creates InventTrans pair: -RECV, +STORAGE (lot preserved)
BR-4A-006: Over-receipt > tolerance_pct requires manager approval
BR-4A-007: Weighbridge net_weight updates receipt line net_weight_kg
outbound: BR-4B-001: SO original_qty is immutable after approved
BR-4B-003: FIFO allocation: oldest inventory first
BR-4B-005: Cannot ship more than allocated qty
BR-4B-006: Weighbridge verification captures weight but does NOT change inventory
BR-4B-007: Post-ship residual at SHIPPING auto-generates putaway work
transfer: BR-4C-001: Transfer source and dest warehouse must be different
BR-4C-002: Transfer preserves lot_id across warehouses
BR-4C-003: IN_TRANSIT status visible in on_hand at source warehouse
BR-4C-004: Transit loss = shipped - received → auto-adjustment
BR-4C-005: Adjustment over threshold requires approval
